fusions.name: Knuckle Vault
fusions.desc: Vaults you on your knuckles to a target up to 6 tiles away, then deals 14 damage and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Drumming Fists
fusions.desc: Pounds the ground, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles with a 40% chance to leave each [Weakened] for 4 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Showing Off
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 12 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 10 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Backed Against the Trunk
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 35%, your physical damage rises 40% for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds. You also have 5% more dodge chance.
